title: My AI coworkers run the meetings. I play darts.
author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
selftext:
Been building this solo with Claude Code.

Everyone in the studio has their own personality, moods, and relationships. Give them a goal, they hold a meeting and work out a plan. You review it, sign off, and go play darts while they get to work.

All the 3D models except the characters are generated with Blender Python scripts.

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: What’s the overall goal of the game?

comments.author: evilsniperxv
comments.body: What connector are you using for the 3d models? Claude? ChatGPT? Some other one?

replies.author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
replies.body: No connector, actually. Everything except the people is a Python script that builds the model in Blender, and I wrote those scripts with Claude Code. So every desk, plant and building is code, which keeps it all in one style and lets me regenerate anything. The characters are BoZo's Stylized Modular Characters with Mixamo animations.

comments.author: reh-dit-causes-aids
comments.body: How are you getting such quick responses from the AI inside the game - I have claude acting as the characters in a game I'm working on and the turn around time is about 15 - 20 seconds from me sending a message to getting an ingame in character response.

replies.author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
replies.body: Good eye! For the recording I used DeepSeek Flash with low effort and capped tokens. The agents still run in Claude Code, the model is just a setting. Most of the latency is thinking time, so lowering effort helps the most.

replies.author: reh-dit-causes-aids
replies.body: really helpful thank you. what is the actual goal or purpose in your game btw?

replies.author: Vegetable-Cod-5098
replies.body: It's a management sim, so it's open-ended like Game Dev Tycoon or The Sims. You grow the studio and look after the crew, and meanwhile they're doing your real work.

replies.author: reh-dit-causes-aids
replies.body: Fantastic, I adored software inc. do you plan to release it at any point? or is it just a personal project?
